results.name: AC-SELECTED-ROUTE: a direct Hard-safe leg selects its Log even when the physical map has a gap
AC-NEGATIVE: a full hard seal cannot be traversed or demolished
AC-NONLOG: an additional hard divider makes destroying the log pointless
AC-CLASSIFY: unsupported Destructible stays solid; Ignore overrides compatibility
AC-CANDIDATES: unrelated living Building and Barrier do not suppress blocking Log
AC-DYNAMIC: classification changes without AABB movement invalidate the decision
AC-PHASE: fixed Log changes to rolling, charging or failed without stale demolition
AC-MULTI-COLLIDER: both colliders belong to the same Log and either can be attacked
AC-LIFECYCLE: EnemyMinion moves, hits once, destroys and resumes original objective

AC-DAMAGE: EnemyMinion no Visual hits once through real fallback
